Explicit merchant enrollment boundary mandated by the migration Spike: new settings return null before first save, so false is the only safe default; while disabled, the six legacy values render exactly as before HDL-03.

Canonical profile selector. Unknown or unset runtime input normalizes to modern with needs_review per contracts/preset-resolution.md; conditions preset_engine_enabled=true (Spike-proven equality shape); runtime correctness does not depend on visibility. Emits the unstyled evidence marker class hadeel-preset-{profile} (class_marker: true) while the engine is on — intentionally no SCSS selector; the checker pins twig parity.

Static panel heading opening the explicit Presets group (FR-001): the group holds the engine switch, profile selector, scope note, and six mode controls, basic before advanced, with no legacy control inside.

The single approved static explanation of Follow-versus-Custom scope (T022); deliberately unconditioned because the equality-condition shape is Spike-proven only for valued controls and runtime never depends on it.
